turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Good morning. How can I help?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Hi. I have an appointment for a haircut at ten. My name's Alex.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Let me check. I have you here for Wednesday at ten, not today.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Wednesday? Are you sure? I booked it on the phone on Monday, and the text message says Tuesday at ten.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Oh, I see. I'm sorry, it looks like we typed the wrong day.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: That's okay, but I really need it today. I have to be at work at twelve. Is anyone free this morning?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: A stylist is free at ten forty. It takes about forty-five minutes. Or there's another free appointment at one thirty.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: One thirty doesn't work, because I'll be at work. If I start at ten forty, I'll finish at about eleven thirty, right?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Great, I'll wait. Could you also cancel the Wednesday booking, please?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Of course. Ten forty today, and Wednesday is cancelled. Would you like a coffee while you wait?
